orb_entry_confirmation_bar.description: Skip an ORB entry if the bar immediately after the breakout bar (5 min later) has already reversed back beyond the breakout level. Control = current v4 rules (take every signal). Treatment = the proposed filter.
orb_entry_confirmation_bar.backtest_ref: 81wk/1046-trade backtest: +26.5% to total P&L, holds in both split halves (+39.7% / +18.4%)
orb_entry_confirmation_bar.decision_rule: Once >= min_days_before_decision real trading days are recorded: if cumulative treatment P&L > cumulative control P&L, ready for human commit to TRADING-STRATEGY.md. If treatment P&L <= control P&L, propose dropping it (move to STRATEGY-PROPOSALS-REJECTED.md) instead of committing. Below min_days, report progress only — no decision either way.

rsi_overbought_entry.description: Skip an ORB entry taken at extreme RSI (long >= 80 / short <= 20) that has NO supporting catalyst (news that backs the trade's direction). Catalyst-aware: extreme-RSI entries WITH a supporting catalyst are kept. Control = current v4 rules (take every signal). Treatment = the catalyst-aware skip.
rsi_overbought_entry.backtest_ref: No backtest — live-only discovery from the 2026-07-27 recommendation review (journal/india/FINDINGS-2026-07-27.md, N=7-11, confounded). This experiment IS the evidence-gathering; no prior offline validation exists.
rsi_overbought_entry.catalyst_note: The core question is the CATALYST correlation, not RSI alone: 2026-07-27 showed RSI-extreme entries with a supporting catalyst (CHOLAFIN, RSI 85, Q1 +21%) won, while RSI-extreme entries without one (ABFRL/TCS/HCLTECH) lost. Catalyst polarity comes from journal/india/catalysts.jsonl, populated by the daily research pass; the per-day page reports the catalyst-supported vs catalyst-less split explicitly. If catalysts.jsonl stops being maintained, unknown=none (conservative) and the treatment degrades toward RSI-only — watch the 'catalyst source' coverage before trusting a decision.
rsi_overbought_entry.decision_rule: Once >= min_days_before_decision real trading days are recorded: if cumulative treatment P&L > cumulative control P&L AND the catalyst-supported vs catalyst-less split on RSI-extreme entries is directionally consistent (supported outperforms unsupported), ready for human review + TRADING-STRATEGY.md commit. Otherwise propose dropping (move to STRATEGY-PROPOSALS-REJECTED.md). Below min_days, report progress only. Higher min_days (10) than confirmation-bar because there was no offline backtest — all evidence is being gathered live.

disable_shorts.description: Drop all SHORT ORB signals; keep longs unchanged. Control = take longs + shorts (current). Treatment = long-only. Motivated by the 2026-07-29 long/short split: shorts net -Rs445 over 6 trades (33% WR) vs longs +Rs195 over 23 (43% WR), with 07-28's 4 shorts all losing (two into positive catalysts).
disable_shorts.backtest_ref: No backtest — live-only, motivated by the long/short split (scripts/pnl_split.py). N=6 shorts so far, tiny; this experiment IS the evidence-gathering.
disable_shorts.decision_rule: Recording starts 2026-07-30 (started). Once >= min_days_before_decision real trading days with >=1 short in the control are recorded: if cumulative treatment (long-only) P&L > cumulative control P&L, ready for human review + a TRADING-STRATEGY.md commit that disables the short sleeve. Otherwise propose dropping (shorts stay enabled). Caveat: N=6 shorts today and 2 were the sample's best trades — do NOT disable on <10 short-bearing days of evidence.

skip_contra_catalyst.description: Skip any signal whose catalyst OPPOSES its direction (LONG into a negative catalyst, SHORT into a positive catalyst). Keep catalyst-neutral ('none') and catalyst-supportive trades. Control = take every signal; treatment = skip contra-catalyst signals. Surgical alternative to disable_shorts.
skip_contra_catalyst.backtest_ref: Retrospective on the live sample (not a decision): 07-27 +Rs309 (skip SAIL long into weak Q1), 07-28 +Rs791 (skip INFY+OFSS shorts into +ve catalysts), 07-29 +Rs0 (no contra — kept KAYNES winner). Total +Rs1,100 over 3 days, 0 damage to the winning day.
skip_contra_catalyst.decision_rule: Recording starts 2026-07-30. Once >= min_days_before_decision real trading days are recorded: if cumulative treatment P&L > cumulative control P&L, ready for human review + a TRADING-STRATEGY.md commit adding the contra-catalyst skip to the buy-side gate. Otherwise propose dropping. Depends on catalysts.jsonl being populated (catalyst scan) — days with no catalyst data contribute 0 delta and are effectively no-ops.
